category_type.description:
`marketing` (the default): recipients can opt out of it, and sends skip recipients who did. `transactional`: for messages a recipient must get, such as receipts or password resets. Sends ignore opt-outs, and the category doesn't appear on the preferences page. Set `message_category_type` on a workflow message step to the type of its category.

* `marketing` - Marketing
* `transactional` - Transactional

description.description: Internal notes about which messages belong to this category. Recipients don't see it.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this message category.

name.description: Display name of the category, shown in the PostHog app.

public_description.description: Description that recipients see next to the category on the preferences page.
